item.title: Anderson: At Crane Lake, walleyes bite only ‘intermittently,’ but a great opener again
item.description: The fishing opener tradition continues in the far north among cold temperatures, and a stiff wind.

item.title: Lynx blow 19-point lead in 91-90 loss to Atlanta to open WNBA season
item.description: The Dream took their first and only lead of the game on a jumper by Te-Hina Paopao with 11.3 seconds left, spoiling a strong debut for Lynx rookie Olivia Miles.

item.title: Former Lakeville Mayor Matt Little wins DFL endorsement for Rep. Angie Craig’s seat
item.description: Little will still face a primary challenge from state Sen. Matt Klein and state Rep. Kaela Berg in August.

item.title: In one small Minnesota city, less than half of kindergartners are vaccinated for measles
item.description: In Menahga, a tight-knit religious community and rising exemptions have pushed vaccination rates far below herd immunity, raising concerns about a potential outbreak.

item.title: Live replay: Wild skate past Avalanche 5-1 in Game 3 as Jesper Wallstedt returns and Kirill Kaprizov gets a goal and two assists
item.description: Colorado still leads the best-of-seven NHL Stanley Cup series 2-1, but suffered its first loss of the playoffs.

item.title: Election judge who allowed 11 unregistered people to vote pleads guilty
item.description: Minnesota Secretary of State’s office is unaware of any election judge facing similar charges.

item.title: No evidence of arson found in White Bear Lake fire that killed Jessi Pierce and 3 children
item.description: The cause is still under investigation, but so far there is nothing that suggests the fire was intentionally set.

item.title: Duluth’s vintage Chinese restaurant turned cocktail den will close April 4
item.description: Plus, a fond farewell to Sun Street Breads, a Viking-sized deal at Parlour and two iconic ice cream stands are open for spring.

item.title: Happy Joe’s hopes Minnesotans are hungry for nostalgia and taco pizza
item.description: Fans of the franchise are looking forward to a summer opening in Mendota Heights.

item.title: Deadly crash that killed four family members ‘touched so many lives’ in rural Minnesota town
item.description: A crash in southwestern Minnesota on Friday involving an SUV and a family’s party bus left a total of five dead and eight injured.

item.title: Willie Nelson’s Outlaw Music Fest coming to Shakopee in 2026
item.description: So much for the Farm Aid concert in Minneapolis being the music icon’s last stand. He’ll be back Aug. 19 with guests including the Avett Brothers.

item.title: Gophers hire Brett Larson to be men’s hockey coach
item.description: Larson, 53, replaces Bob Motzko, who he also succeeded at St. Cloud State. Larson had a 153-116-23 record in eight seasons with the Huskies.

item.title: Airstrikes batter Iran as it attacks Israel and Gulf states, while diplomatic efforts gather pace
item.description: Airstrikes battered Iran and Iranian missiles and drones targeted Israel's Tel Aviv and sites across the Mideast on Tuesday, even as President Donald Trump said the United States was in talks with the Islamic Republic to end the war.

item.title: Audit finds some Minnesota State faculty were paid late or incorrectly
item.description: The Office of the Legislative Auditor looked at payroll issues at four colleges and found that 9% of faculty were paid wrong.

item.title: Live: Tartan builds double-digit lead over Blaine in state tournament quarterfinals
item.description: The winner plays either Chaska or Lakeville South in Thursday’s 4A semifinals at Williams Arena.
